non_claims: this receipt is [bounded] to the named approved fixtures and the single declared real input; it is not corpus coverage
the declared real input is one tracked bounded Consultant WordML fixture, not the restricted corpus (consru_export/exports/); no decoded legal text enters tracked evidence
counts and sha256 are integrity evidence, not coverage and not source authenticity
this is not a full analysis/context export, not a read-back verifier (S03) and not semantic gold
R1000 stays active and unclosed; this receipt never auto-closes it
frozen oracles and the M213 cleaned wire bytes are not modified

proof_classes.identity: parent identity and document version are taken from the captured manifest+footer; check_parent_citation and check_document_version succeed on the pipeline's own output
proof_classes.coordinates: every projected source segment resolves via resolve_fragment_span to the exact substrate UTF-8 slice; start/end are preserved
proof_classes.block_mapping: caller-side block index -> distinct fragment (D603); resolve_local_span returns the whole fragment for every pinned block
proof_classes.token_views: a covering token of a real fixture fragment validates under the covering view; a cross-view substitution is refused
proof_classes.completion_independence: cleaned-wire Hold and TextOnly completion bases do not change source identity or coordinates
proof_classes.no_corpus_transfer: the envelope carries no inline decoded text; None is accepted and a supplied text channel is refused
proof_classes.bounded_real_input: the declared real input is pinned by byte length and sha256; only counts and hashes are recorded

refusals_observed: SourceIdentityMismatch: tampered source.sha256 and a claimed seal on an unsealed parent
DocumentVersionMismatch: a record revision differing from the envelope triple
CrossDocument: a fragment from the text-only fixture pinned into the mixed fixture envelope
UnsupportedMapping: an XML artifact coordinate kind
CorpusTransferForbidden: an inline decoded text channel
TokenViewMismatch: a morphology outcome declaring the alphabetic view

constraints: S02 must not re-derive coordinates or token views; it materializes records on top of the seam
S02 must record the M214 requirement binding through the sanctioned requirements path before it begins (R1000 primary; R081/R069/R077/R063/R038/R071 supporting-only; nothing auto-closed)
S02 must not claim full analysis/context export or semantic gold and must not auto-close R1000
